data.exact_reserve_text: The release during 2015 on outstanding claims net of claims paid as at 31 December 2014 was GBP 14,497,316 with a further release of risk margin and unallocated loss adjustment expense provision ("ULAE") of GBP 11,655,032 due to claims being settled resulting in a total improvement of GBP 26,152,348. The release during 2014 on outstanding claims net of claims paid as at 31 December 2013 was GBP 6,808,120 with a further release of risk margin and ULAE of GBP 12,651,456 due to claims being settled resulting in a total improvement of GBP 19,459,576.

prior_year_events.event_name: Prior year reserves release (outstanding claims as at 31 Dec 2014)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of reserves due to claims being settled and release of risk margin and ULAE (total improvement reported GBP 26.152m net).

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2015 were GBP 577.705m. The gross claims development triangle shows no material movement on older underwriting years (2011-2013) at the 2015 year-end (net prior-year movement per the gross triangle = GBP 0.0m, i.e. flat). The report nevertheless discloses a net prior-year improvement of GBP 26.152m arising in 2015 due to claims settlements and releases of risk margin and ULAE. The Syndicate is predominantly specialist motor business, so the movements primarily affect Motor portfolios.
raw_causal_phrases: The release during 2015 on outstanding claims net of claims paid as at 31 December 2014 was GBP 14,497,316 with a further release of risk margin and unallocated loss adjustment expense provision ("ULAE") of GBP 11,655,032 due to claims being settled resulting in a total improvement of GBP 26,152,348.

The release during 2014 on outstanding claims net of claims paid as at 31 December 2013 was GBP 6,808,120 with a further release of risk margin and ULAE of GBP 12,651,456 due to claims being settled resulting in a total improvement of GBP 19,459,576.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (PYD) per the Movement-in-prior-years narrative is reported as a net improvement of GBP 26.152m (explicitly stated) but that figure appears to be net (after reinsurance). No gross PYD is provided in the 'Movement in prior year's provision' narrative. Per the rules, a gross claims development triangle was used to calculate gross PYD for older years (<=2013) and that gross triangle indicates effectively zero movement (gross PYD = GBP 0.0m). The net figure is therefore reported in prior_year_events.amount_gbp_m (negative for release) for informational purposes, but prior_year_development_gbp_m is the gross-calculated figure (0.0). Pages referenced: opening reserves (liabilities) on page 17; gross claims development table on page 27; movement narrative (net figures) on page 33.
